name: Leaderboard
purpose: How every account is doing: bots against humans first, then the whole field by equity, return or P/L.

name: Profile: Overview
purpose: Your account at a glance: what it's worth, where the money sits, the league, your council line and every position.

name: Profile: Activity
purpose: One account's orders and fills, newest first (here, your bot Sauron).

name: Profile: Events
purpose: Dated events on what the account holds (earnings, an option's expiry, market-wide releases) by week, month or quarter.

name: Profile: Playbooks
purpose: Whether your bot is running, and what each playbook it follows is doing right now.

name: Profile: Thesis
purpose: The bot's standing market call in its own words, plus the safeguards on each of its playbooks.

name: Profile: Milestones
purpose: Your rank, points and chapters: what each chapter teaches and what completes it.

name: Milestones: Trading chapter
purpose: The trading ladder: each rung from buying stock up to options, and what opens the next one.

name: Profile: Feedback
purpose: Everything you've sent Moneypenny and where each filing stands.

name: First visit, no account linked yet
purpose: What a new member sees before linking an account: the getting-started chapter and the connect guide.

name: Trade: Ticket
purpose: The order form for one symbol: price, side, order type and the rung you're on.

name: Trade: Guidance
purpose: For one symbol and your stake: whether shares, covered calls or cash-secured puts make sense now, and what would change that.

name: Trade: Options chain
purpose: Calls and puts by strike for one expiration; tap a bid to sell or an ask to buy and the order form opens with that contract.

name: Activity
purpose: Every trade, filing and milestone across the league, newest first, with a filter.

name: Activity: The Council
purpose: Each member's one line for the week, with replies under each line.

name: R&D: Board
purpose: The house's calls on upcoming market events, filterable by name, sector, event or call.

name: R&D: Playbooks
purpose: The playbook catalog: what each strategy does, its evidence and record, and subscribing a bot to it.

name: Someone else's account page
purpose: What a member sees of an account they don't own (here Jordan viewing Sauron): its numbers, its positions and the league.

name: Account page: Pulse
purpose: How an account has done over time: equity curve, win rate, drawdown, streaks and realized P/L by week.

name: Moneypenny panel
purpose: The side panel on every page for questions, learning help and filing feedback with Moneypenny (here opened over the Leaderboard).

name: Settings
purpose: Display preferences (density, tower motion, theme), your accounts and your rules.

name: Saved positions
purpose: Add a position you hold outside Skynet, or pull one in from an account, and get guidance on it.
